transparency.cleanupFinding: H5.48B regenerated cleanup removes visible baked checkerboard/background contamination with asset-type-specific transparency correction while preserving source PNG untouched and original 1408x768 layout.

reasons: Visible baked checkerboard/background contamination remained around and inside multiple assets.
Alchemy tray, sorting bin, and round-complete explanatory captions were included in H5.48 regions but are not part of the assets.

functionalSurfaceBoundary.notes: Functional-surface candidate flags are preserved as planning metadata only. H5.48B does not perform functional slot mapping, define gameplay sorting logic, or wire runtime visuals.

cleanupMethod.summary: H5.48B derived-only transparency correction with caption exclusion and asset-type-specific checker cleanup.
cleanupMethod.sourceRectPolicy: Preserve reviewed H5.46/H5.47 sourceRects except for three H5.48B caption exclusions: alchemy tray, sorting bin, and round-complete chest.
cleanupMethod.backgroundRemovalPolicy: Use conservative strict edge cleanup for solid surfaces, labels, badges, and functional candidates; use broadened neutral checker cleanup only for glow/smoke/spill/sparkle/fire-style problem regions; use strict interior cleanup only for empty glass/hourglass-style transparent-looking regions.
cleanupMethod.riskPolicy: Glows, smoke, spills, liquid edges, glass edges, fire, sparkles, baked labels, and small badge details remain human-review risk areas.

captionExclusionCorrection.note: The explanatory sheet captions alchemy tray, sorting bin, and round-complete are excluded from corrected sourceRects and derived cleanup output.
